item.title: Rallying Cry – October 16, 2026
item.description: A Spanish team is pioneering an emissions-free wind sled to explore Antarctica, while a Bengaluru educator is bringing books to the community with a new library, and Bluesky is making AI-powered creativity even more accessible with its expanded Attie app.
